# Supplier Capability Matrix

## When to use this page

Use this screen to review its available records and supported actions.

## Typical tasks

- Follow the documented “Operator steps and checks” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “Screen references” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “List” instructions below.

> Ownership: Purchasing records commercial supplier commitments; Inventory posts physical quantities; Accounting and Payments manage AP and settlement.

## Operator steps and checks

Use **Supplier Product Supports** to record/query which supplier can support a product. This capability view is different from a commercial **Supplier Product Reference**, which is still required by the active, currency-matched sourcing flows. Search and filter support entries to assess the shortlist, then check commercial availability, unit and cost in Supplier Product References before creating an order. A support entry alone does not reserve stock, commit a purchase or create a financial document.
